skills.skill_desc:
Ruby's skills have a 75% Spell Vamp Ratio (her Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal). For every 1% HP lost, her Spell Vamp Ratio increases by 1%, up to 150%.

After each skill cast, Ruby can dash to another location and gain 8-25 <font color="26e407"><1999></font> (scales with level) for 4s (stacks up to 3 times).

Ruby swings her scythe, dealing 280<font color="fba51f"> (+110% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit. She then unleashes a shockwave in the same direction, dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s.

Ruby swings her scythe around herself twice, each swing dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5s, and slowly pulling them toward her.

Ruby sweeps her scythe in the target direction, dealing 600<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit, pulling them toward her, and stunning them for 0.5s.
